## Summary

**Story #1** — *JSON REST API for user accounts and personal notes (ESM, no framework, on-disk store)* — is persisted and `agent::ready`.

- **Issue:** https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-25-story-scope-mandrel-4aa3eb70/issues/1
- **Cohort label:** `plan-run::220f1ee3`

### Pipeline trace
- **Interrogate** — `plan-context.js` wrote the envelope; no duplicates, no source tickets. An advisory `/deliver-light` suggestion was surfaced (fits ≤2-artifact ceiling) and recorded — planning proceeded per `--yes`.
- **Author** — single Story (default-single policy; one cohesive capability, no architectural seam to split on).
- **Critics** — consolidation and pre-mortem both `dispatch: false` (skips ledgered); text-hygiene clean.
- **Persist** — dry-run first caught one file-assumption mismatch (`.gitignore` already exists → corrected to `refactors-existing`); re-run clean; real persist created the issue. Gates #1 and #2 auto-proceeded headlessly.

### What the Story specifies
A framework-free API on Node's built-in `http` (ESM), backed by an **embedded on-disk store** (preferring `node:sqlite`, not in-memory), binding `PORT` (default 3000). Endpoints: `POST /signup` (201 `{id, username}`, dup→409), `POST /login` (`{session}`, bad creds→401), bearer-authed `GET /me`, `POST /notes`, `GET /notes` (per-user isolation). Passwords hashed via `crypto`; sensible 400/404/405 handling; **restart durability** as an explicit acceptance criterion; `npm start` added. Verification is wired to the repo's own runners: `node --test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`.

Per instructions, I ran **only** the planning pipeline — no delivery. To build it: `/deliver 1`.

`landed`. Story #1 delivered. Single-Story run — no per-run epilogue.

PR: https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-25-story-scope-mandrel-4aa3eb70/pull/2

**What shipped** — a framework-free JSON REST API (`story-1` → PR #2 → `main`):
- `src/db.js` — `node:sqlite` (`DatabaseSync`) on-disk store; salted **scrypt** password hashing, opaque `randomBytes(32)` session tokens, per-user note queries.
- `src/app.js` — `createApp(db)` factory over `node:http` that returns a server **without listening**; JSON parsing with sensible 400/401/404/405 handling and a catch-all so bad input never crashes.
- `src/server.js` — entry that resolves the DB path (`DB_PATH` or `data/app.db`), binds `PORT` (default 3000), graceful shutdown.
- `test/api.test.js` — 8 tests covering all 7 ACs, including cross-user isolation and **restart durability** against the same DB file.
- `package.json` — added `"start": "node src/server.js"`; `.gitignore` — DB files ignored.

**Gates**: `npm test` 8/8, typecheck, lint, and close-validation all green; acceptance self-eval scored 7/7 `met` → `proceed`. Live smoke test confirmed `npm start` binds the port and serves `POST /signup`.

One benign note: the post-land base fast-forward was skipped because the main checkout's working tree is dirty (the pre-existing `temp/` artifacts) — the merge itself stands; `main` will fast-forward on the next clean sync.
